items.subject: Could Aucert sponsor a family this holiday?

args.subject: Could Aucert sponsor a family this holiday?
args.content:
Hi Vivek and Rajesh,

Congrats on building Aucert.

I'm Harshit, founder of CouponDonation. Families in the US post what they need, like groceries or medicine, and donors cover it. No cash changes hands: each gift becomes a gift card for the store the family asked for, and the donor gets an email when it's used.

Would your team sponsor a family this holiday season? Every dollar of your gift goes to the family, and you can choose who you help at coupondonation.com.

We're a company, not a charity, so gifts aren't tax-deductible. If giving isn't a fit right now, I'd still value 15 minutes of founder-to-founder feedback.

Thanks,
Harshit Agrawal
Founder, CouponDonation

CouponDonation Inc., 300 Creek View Road, Suite 209, Newark, DE 19711
If you'd rather not hear from me, reply "no thanks" and I won't write again.
